scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @viavoip/protocol build && pnpm --filter @viavoip/sm-adapter build && pnpm --filter @viavoip/internal-domain build && pnpm -r exec tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @viavoip/protocol build && pnpm --filter @viavoip/sm-adapter build && pnpm --filter @viavoip/internal-domain build && pnpm -r --if-present test
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @viavoip/protocol build && pnpm --filter @viavoip/sm-adapter build && pnpm --filter @viavoip/internal-domain build && pnpm --filter @viavoip/server dev
scripts.seed: pnpm --filter @viavoip/protocol build && pnpm --filter @viavoip/sm-adapter build && pnpm --filter @viavoip/internal-domain build && pnpm --filter @viavoip/server seed
